QUOTE: "`ExperimentalViewArchivedChannels` is a single boolean gate, and only an explicit `'false'` turns it off. When the server omits the setting, the app treats archived channels as viewable, the same as `'true'`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states directly that an absent setting means archived channels are viewable and only an explicit 'false' disables it, citing `value !== 'false'`.
